sources.fact: GET https://apis.moment.kakao.com/openapi/v4/adAccounts/pages uses a Business bearer token; page/size default 0/10. Response: content(id,name,config,memberType), number,size,totalElements,totalPages,page. Requires usage permission and Biz app.

GET /openapi/v4/campaigns uses bearer authorization and adAccountId header; optional config. content projects id,name,config,systemConfig. The list does not guarantee an account field. Create has no documented initial config input; example returns ON. No safe creation assumption.

GET /openapi/v4/adAccounts/report: explicit start/end yyyyMMdd, inclusive <=31 days, timeUnit=DAY, level=AD_ACCOUNT, metricsGroup=BASIC, adAccountId query plus single-account header. Response code=200, data(start,end,dimensions,metrics); no-data may have empty dimensions/metrics. BASIC is not Message reporting.

sources.quote: You cannot make a call within 5 seconds
sources.fact: Account reports: one call per five seconds, scoped by ad account for single-account requests and app for multiple-account requests. No plugin polling, quota state or retries.

BASIC metrics: imp, click, ctr, cost, video_play_3s, vtr. Config: ON/OFF/DEL; user configuration is distinct from system/delivery state. Output consumes only validated projections. Data type table states yyyyMMdd but report samples use yyyy-MM-dd; decoder accepts both and preserves the provider strings.

sources.quote: Automatically expires after long periods of inactivity.
sources.fact: Business tokens differ from ordinary Kakao Login tokens. moment_management authorizes management APIs. R1 accepts pasted Business tokens only; no inferred lifetime or refresh.

sources.quote: The time zone is KST (Korea Standard Time).
sources.fact: Kakao support woody.ho confirmed report timezone on 2026-10-08. Guard excludes current/future KST dates using injected time; output preserves provider dates without UTC conversion.
Quota errors include HTTP 429 and HTTP 400 code -10. Permission errors use 403. Provider payloads are discarded after bounded parsing; failures remain redacted and non-retryable.
